findings.old: The numerical occurrences of the mīm upon it are forty
findings.new: The numerical value assigned to the mīm is forty
findings.reason: Canonical L17: وأعداد الميم الواقعة عليه أربعون states the number/value assigned to mīm; it does not say that the letter occurs forty times. “Occurrences” changes a numerical value into a frequency count.

findings.old: Jumlah kemunculan numerik mīm padanya adalah empat puluh
findings.new: Nilai numerik yang ditetapkan bagi mīm adalah empat puluh
findings.reason: Canonical L17: وأعداد الميم الواقعة عليه أربعون gives the assigned numerical value forty, not forty occurrences (kemunculan) of mīm.

findings.old: and brings its form and image together with the seven forms for the seven days
findings.new: ; its form and image come with the seven forms for the seven days
findings.reason: Canonical L26-27: هو زائد لمن تأمل ذلك وأتى شكله وصورته مع الأشكال السبعة للأيام السبعة. The arrival/appearance clause أتى شكله وصورته concerns its form and image; it does not instruct the contemplator to bring them together. Keep the existing uncertainty marker for the awkward overall sentence, but remove the invented human actor/action.

findings.old: dan menghadirkan bentuk serta gambarnya bersama tujuh bentuk untuk tujuh hari
findings.new: ; bentuk serta gambarnya hadir bersama tujuh bentuk untuk tujuh hari
findings.reason: Canonical L26-27: هو زائد لمن تأمل ذلك وأتى شكله وصورته مع الأشكال السبعة للأيام السبعة. أتى شكله وصورته describes the form and image coming/appearing, not an act of the contemplator presenting them. Retain the surrounding uncertainty marker without assigning an unsupported actor.
